title: Health-diet.ru
description: A complete nutritional database built from 13,000+ food products across every category on the site – calories, protein, fat, and carbohydrates for each item. The scraper handles the full catalog reliably: it detects and skips empty categories automatically, and uses rate-limited requests to avoid overloading the source site. Results are structured and exported to JSON.

title: Soccerwiki.org
description: A two-stage scraper covering all 20 English Premier League clubs and their full squads. It first collects team links from the league page, then visits each club page to extract details (founding year, stadium, manager) by parsing labeled text fields with fallback handling for inconsistent formatting. Player nationalities are aggregated across all clubs into a sorted frequency count – covering 900+ players from over 70 countries – and exported to structured JSON.

title: Subslikescript.com
description: Automated collection of movie metadata and plot summaries, built on the same reusable scraping framework used for Leroy Merlin. Configured with static letter categories (A–E) and a two-tab custom parser — one tab holds the paginated listing, a second opens each movie's detail page to extract its full plot, keeping listing state intact throughout. Successfully passed an automated JavaScript challenge the site added mid-project, without any manual intervention. Delivered 15,600+ unique films across 500+ pages, exported to JSON and CSV per letter.

title: Audible.com
description: Automated collection of audiobook metadata from Audible's search catalog — title, author, and duration for 500 listings across 25 result pages, out of a full catalog exceeding 60,000 titles. Built with Selenium to handle the site's dynamically rendered content, the scraper auto-detects the total number of pages from the pagination bar rather than relying on a fixed range, and correctly handles entries with multiple listed authors or editors. Results are exported to CSV and JSON.

title: Transfermarkt.com
description: Automated collection of UEFA Champions League top goalscorer statistics via Transfermarkt's internal data endpoint, extracting player name, position, nationality, age, club, and goals for each entry. The scraper detects the total number of pages automatically and queries the site's AJAX pagination endpoint directly rather than emulating browser clicks, keeping the process lightweight and fast. Multi-nationality players (multiple flags per row) are handled correctly. Results are exported to CSV and JSON.

title: Otodom.pl
description: An automated pipeline collecting apartment listings from Otodom.pl, Poland's major real estate portal. Built with Playwright to handle dynamic content, the scraper auto-detects the total number of result pages and distinguishes single listings from multi-unit developments using dedicated parsing logic. Retry logic with exponential backoff ensures reliability, while results are stored in PostgreSQL with upsert logic to avoid duplicates on repeated runs.

title: Leroymerlin.co.za
description: A reusable, config-driven scraping framework rather than a single-site script — new sites are added through configuration alone. Applied to Leroy Merlin South Africa's garden & landscaping catalog, it handles a dynamic, Algolia-powered product grid across 22 categories with atomic, resumable progress per category. Delivered 12,600+ unique products across 700+ pages, exported to JSON and CSV.
